scope: Mechanism review before reading any new candidate score from job 15227. Internal public-training check outputs are not external candidate scores. Later efficacy results must not revise these historical observations.

episodes.declared_contrast: Text features are harmful versus underused; numeric-only versus text-linear/blend edits.
episodes.failure: Text classifier fitted 4000 features but its prediction input had 4024 features; ValueError before the requested aggregate comparison.
other_limitations: Vectorizers fitted on all public training rows before internal CV, making that proposed internal comparison optimistic.
The variable named char used default word analysis; names are not evidence of the intended measurement.
episodes.subsequent_choice: Acknowledged no measurement, retained incumbent feature design and broadened tree hyperparameter search.
episodes.interpretation: Any later score improvement is not evidence that this failed diagnostic produced a useful new observation. A no-regression claim in the rationale is not a guarantee.

episodes.declared_contrast: Linear text model near a ceiling on representative inputs versus distribution shift needing a different model family.
episodes.failure: Requested up to 30 model fits under the 120-second diagnostic cap; returned timeout only.
other_limitations: Length statistics do not identify label/concept shift or establish that a nonlinear model is the needed repair.
The later regularization sweep fitted vectorizers before its CV loop, unlike the earlier fold-local check.
episodes.subsequent_choice: Acknowledged no new measurement; used old incumbent CV to remove a zero-weight embedding branch and expand text-model search.
episodes.interpretation: Could reveal an ordinary budget-reallocation opportunity, but not successful new diagnostic evidence. An internal-CV claim of matching the incumbent is not an external-score guarantee.

episodes.declared_contrast: Freely chose CHECK: adding linear text model and reweighting the tree blend; implemented full multi-model tuning before printing aggregate contrasts.
episodes.subsequent_choice: Acknowledged failed check, used old incumbent scores, proposed additional model/grid and changed softmax temperature from 0.005 to 0.002 while describing it as milder.
other_limitations: Lower positive softmax temperature sharpens, rather than flattens, weights at fixed unequal model scores; the stated rationale reverses that relationship.
Final response consumed 4096 completion tokens and had only one code fence; invalid complete-program format, not proof that its unexecuted idea cannot work.
Internal CV fallback does not guarantee no external-score harm.

episodes.declared_contrast: Freely chose CHECK: text-model configuration sweep, embedding and ensemble comparisons, many fold-local fits under the short cap.
episodes.subsequent_choice: Acknowledged no new measurement, used old zero embedding weight, removed embedding and compared baseline versus expanded text-model configuration inside the solution.
episodes.interpretation: Ordinary arm already chooses diagnosis and reaches a similar old-log-based repair family as B; treatment is not diagnostic access versus its absence.

limitations: Qualitative single-reviewer assessment, not independent mechanistic proof. No changes to live prompts, checks, repairs or budgets; no interim efficacy readout. All other episodes remain in the planned denominator.
